'''2018 Worlds Day 2 Trevor Partridge DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Trevor Partridge]] at [[2018 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Trevor Partridge]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127123938/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-world-championships/ Internet Archive]
